hooks.name: README links stay alive
hooks.description: Runs Revenant's own CLI (from source) on the root README.md when it is saved. Exit 1 on any dead or possessed link; the printed lines go back to the agent. Restless links print but do not fail.

hooks.name: Sample verdicts match their comment
hooks.description: Runs the CLI on every samples/*.md that has an expected-verdicts comment and prints only links whose verdict differs from it.
